ambient_events: The black is so complete it hums.
The chair waits. It has always been waiting.
Far off, or maybe very close, something that isn't a screen prepares to become one.
description: Black. Complete, felted black, the kind that presses on your eyes. A single metal chair sits in a pool of nothing, bolted to a floor you can feel but not see, facing a wall that hasn't decided to exist yet. There is nothing else. There is nowhere else to look. The chair is, unmistakably, for you.
name: The Broadcast
